a: Allopatric speciation occurs with geographic isolation.
Analogous structures have similar function but different ancestry.
Vestigial structures are reduced remnants of ancestral features.
Archaea are single-celled organisms distinct from bacteria and eukaryotes.
Eukaryotes have a nucleus and membrane-bound organelles.
Viruses require host cells to replicate.
Antibiotic resistance evolves under selective pressure of antibiotic use.
